description: The conjugate of an integer partition, read down the columns of its Ferrers diagram. Parts must be positive and nonincreasing. The empty partition is its own conjugate. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/partition-conjugate
